story.thread: The brutalist fil rouge is CONTINUOUS motion at rest — the page never collapses into a bank of fire-once IntersectionObserver reveals with dead silence between them. This is the archetype's divergence from minimalist, but the AMPLITUDE of that continuous motion is a PER-BRIEF CHOICE, NOT universally loud (correction from revision 1): it spans the MAXIMALIST register (Eloy runs a scrubbed flower-pluck field scrub:8 + different-speed title rows yPercent -300 scrub:0.6 that shear the whole scroll, plus scramble-on-hover on every labeled element — the site titles itself 'Mayhem') and the RESTRAINED register (Naked City runs a single rAF loop that keeps every section subtly moving, framed by its makers as 'restraint paired with intensity … movement without chaos', explicitly NOT loud-at-rest). The brutalist-adjacent FlowFest sits at the loud end with a ~75px/s marquee + cursor-tracked mascot idle loop + a self-drawing DrawSVG arch, but it is a colorful-illustration BOUNDARY member, not the law's proof. The carry holds three constants across all element geometries: ONE physical metaphor (objects-on-a-table / terminal-runtime / CRT-film / print-shop), ONE easing family (scroll reveals ride expo.out/power3; the jarring steps(n) register is reserved for hero type + micro-toggles), and ONE border/shadow/radius system (Sui 2px #000F1D + radius 0 + structural fill; FlowFest hard offset shadow 0 4px 0 that collapses on press). When a control fills it takes the FULL saturated accent, never a pale color-mix tint. The failure mode ('the dead middle') is a bank of fire-once reveals with nothing running between them; the winning move welds one décor layer to the scrollbar and keeps one idle loop alive in-character — at whatever amplitude the brief's register calls for. Do not force a loud marquee onto a restraint brief.
story.copy: Two registers, both refusing corporate distance; the button is ALWAYS a verb. Terminal-ironic (Eloy, the canonical brutalist source): lowercase, >>> prefixes, ALL-CAPS verbs, // and # fences — '>>>based in madrid, spain'; '##########COPY EMAIL##' (the CTA as a terminal command). Warm-communal (FlowFest, boundary-adjacent): first-plural, exclamatory, hot imperatives, trailing ellipses, a named human and a real address — 'Hi Friends!' → 'We are back...' (the loader speaks in character); 'Webflow chat, festival vibes, good times.' (H1 = the pitch in three noun phrases); 'Reach out to Isabel at isabel@designsie.co.uk...'. Quoted to CALIBRATE, never to ship: imitate the specificity (the named place, the count, the refusal), never the wording. Indexed ASCII flags ([ MANIFEST 04 ]) and process strings (REV 2.6) are legitimate brutalist grammar, not meta-label noise.

spectacle_model.hero: A COMMITTED in-character scene, never a quiet opener — no genuine brutalist winner ships zero-intro instant paint. A loader that SIGNS its character (char-diff identity tags that swap '>>>based in madrid, spain' → '>>>born in mar del plata, arg' via TextPlugin type:'diff' 0.3s and loader-into-navbar where the progress bar grows into the nav — Eloy, winner-verified; OR a chat-cloud typed beats 'Hi Friends!'→'We are back...' — FlowFest, boundary-adjacent; OR a stepped counter steps(14) 0→100 — Joffrey, technique) hands off to a type-as-image or identity reveal: char-diff identity tags (Eloy) or a drawn inline-SVG <path> H1 slab whose spans rise yPercent 100→0 stagger −0.025 Expo.easeOut (FlowFest, params reference-carried not re-read this run). The first impression forms in this scene; the only in-fold CTA is the nav pill (argument) or none at all (studio-index).
continuation: what-is / about (understanding) — masked line/char reveals fire ONCE while the CONTINUOUS idle carry runs UNDER them at the brief's register amplitude: maximalist = scrubbed flower-pluck scrub:8 + different-speed title rows yPercent -300 scrub:0.6 (Eloy, winner-verified) or marquee + mascot idle loop tracking the cursor (FlowFest, boundary-adjacent, params reference-carried); restraint = a single perpetual rAF loop keeping sections subtly in motion (Naked City). CONTINUES — never a hard silence, but not necessarily loud.

Naked City Films (SOTD 2026-01-23): a single rAF loop binds smooth scroll + Three.js render + element-entry + page transitions so no section is fully motionless — BUT the makers frame this as 'restraint paired with intensity … movement without chaos', the RESTRAINED register, not loud-at-rest. The peak COUNT caps at one spectacle across the genuine-fit members — Eloy stacks no second peak equal to the footer clone machine. Refinement, not inversion: one spectacle peak capped, continuous carry between it — amplitude per brief (maximalist ↔ restrained), NOT universally loud. Revision 1's absolute 'one wow then quiet describes ZERO brutalist winners' is dropped as unfalsifiable and contradicted by Naked City's restraint framing.
spectacle_model.recommended_law: Brutalist Phase-4 law (revision 2): the hero commits an IN-CHARACTER scene (a loader that SIGNS its character — identity-terminal char-diff / chat-cloud typed beats / stepped counter / loader-into-navbar — handing into a type-as-image or identity reveal); no zero-intro instant paint. Cap the spectacle peak at ONE and place it at the PROOF (work-index / lineup ~40%) or the FOOTER (clone-machine / oversized reprise) — rarely the hero (the hero is a committed scene at sub-peak intensity ~8). Between and around it, run a CONTINUOUS idle carry hero→footer so the page never becomes a bank of fire-once reveals with dead silence — at minimum ONE scrubbed décor field welded to global scroll, plus (register-dependent) a marquee and one in-character idle loop. CRITICAL CORRECTION from revision 1: the carry's amplitude is a PER-BRIEF CHOICE, not universally loud — the maximalist register (Eloy 'Mayhem': scrubbed pluck + sheared title rows + scramble) and the restrained register (Naked City: a single perpetual rAF loop framed as 'movement without chaos') are BOTH award-winning; do not force a loud marquee onto a restraint brief. When a marquee IS in register, couple its speed + skew to scroll velocity (the documented Osmo winner variant) rather than a fixed px/s. The divergence from minimalist is that the continuous motion renders the archetype's physical metaphor IN-CHARACTER, not that it is loud. The failure mode is the 'dead middle'; a second spectacle peak equal to the first dilutes.

algorithm.rule: Studio / portfolio / agency where the work IS the argument → studio-index (The Studio Index, the PRIMARY brutalist spine): terminal-ironic voice, loader-into-navbar or identity-terminal hero, NO in-fold CTA, footer-as-finale peak. Event / festival / conference / product-with-a-lineup → argument-scroll (The Community Scroll): warm-communal voice, in-character loader, proof = the lineup (~40% peak), oversized reprise-CTA close — note this spine's grounding member (FlowFest) is a colorful-illustration boundary site, so keep its warmth from tipping the palette out of the brutalist system. Reel / showreel showcase → studio-reel (The Stepped Reel): stepped-counter loader → Flip showreel → scrubbed case slider → contact close. Deterministic by brief type; never blend two spines.

algorithm.decide: Physical metaphor + the CONTINUOUS idle carry (the fil rouge)
algorithm.rule: Pick ONE physical metaphor and commit a CONTINUOUS idle carry that renders it. Minimum viable carry = ONE scrubbed décor field welded to GLOBAL scroll (DrawSVG line-draw scrub:0 / pixel-field pluck scrub:8). Then set amplitude by the brief's register: LOUD/maximalist brief → add a marquee band AND one in-character idle loop (cursor-tracked mascot / self-drawing mark / shuffling carousel); RESTRAINT brief → keep the carry to the single scrubbed field plus subtle perpetual motion (a single rAF loop), no marquee. When a marquee IS in register, couple its speed and skew to scroll velocity (proxy skew via gsap.quickSetter, ScrollTrigger onUpdate, velocity/−300 clamp, ease back to 0) rather than a fixed px/s — the velocity-reactive marquee is the documented Osmo winner variant and it survives touch as a scroll-driven channel; a constant px/s band is the tamer fallback. Hold three constants across ALL element geometries: (a) one accent, full-saturated on fill — never a color-mix(accent,white) tint; (b) one easing family — bind scroll reveals to expo.out/power3 and RESERVE the jarring steps(n) register for hero type + micro-toggles only; (c) one border/shadow/radius system — either 2px near-black border + radius 0 + structural background-color fill (Sui), or hard offset shadow 0 4px 0 that collapses on press (FlowFest), or the warm round-button variant where the TYPE does the brutalist work. Channel-collision rule (deterministic, replaces the old taste call): each element class owns a distinct (trigger × property) pair; if two classes would animate the SAME property on the SAME trigger, reassign one to a different trigger (scroll-scrub / hover / idle) or a different property (transform / opacity / filter) so no two classes share a (trigger, property) pair.
evidence: Eloy: scrubbed flower-pluck scrub:8 + title rows yPercent -300 scrub:0.6, terminal-runtime metaphor (Codrops-verified to the number — canonical brutalist source)
Naked City: restraint register — a single rAF loop is the whole carry, no marquee ('movement without chaos', Codrops-verified)

Velocity-coupled marquee variant: gsap.quickSetter proxy skew + ScrollTrigger onUpdate + velocity/−300 clamp (GSAP 'skew on scroll velocity' + 'Velocity Image Marquee' reference demos; Osmo house technique — the FlowFest studio)
Sui: 2px #000F1D border, radius 0, full-accent structural fill (award verified; CSS params reference-carried, see unverified)

Hand off to a type-as-image or identity reveal: char-diff identity tags TextPlugin type:'diff' 0.3s (Eloy), or a drawn inline-SVG <path> H1 slab, spans yPercent 100→0 stagger −0.025 Expo.easeOut (FlowFest, reference-carried). One in-fold CTA (nav pill) for argument; none for studio-index. Then nav drops (yPercent −102→0) and welcome cards stagger. Author the loader hidden so no-JS never blocks the page.

algorithm.rule: For roles whose form EXISTS, pick by role. For roles whose form is flagged MISSING in `gaps` (lineup-grid, faq-accordion, identity-terminal-hero, footer-clone-machine, chat-cloud-loader, index-hover-preview), AUTHOR the component FIRST from its `gaps` mechanic spec, then pick it — do NOT hand-improvise ad-hoc section layout. Role → form map: hero → type-as-image (drawn-SVG H1 slab) OR identity-terminal-hero (author from gaps), caption text-emphasis-fill. what-is/about → editorial-split, h2 char-assemble, prose text-emphasis-fill + semantic-accent. lineup (proof peak) → lineup-grid (author from gaps), rows index-row-hover + cards tilt-parity-figure + labels scramble-decode. work-index (studio-index proof) → index-list, rows spotlight-dim + optional index-hover-preview (author from gaps). community → logo-wall (grayscale→colour hover). FAQ → faq-accordion (author from gaps, the rest). close → close-panel (argument: reprised CTA at largest type) OR footer-clone-machine (author from gaps, studio-index deferred peak). footer → CTA-reprise oversized-wordmark / footer-spectacle. Weld the scrubbed décor layer behind ALL of it.

algorithm.rule: cta: hard-shadow press (box-shadow 0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15) → translateY(0.25em), shadow collapses to 0, ~0.25s — no fill, no colour change) OR full-accent structural fill (border 2px solid, radius 0, background→FULL accent, label colour holds, background-color 0.3s) — never a pale tint. link: underline draw from the leading edge (2px currentColor pseudo, scaleX 0→1, transform-origin:left, text colour unchanged, gated @media(hover:hover) and prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference) OR colour dim/shift no-underline over color 0.35s for dense text menus (director lists / indexes). figure: rotate-tilt by parity (±3° alternating per nth-child; stickers peel ±5° with scale) OR RGB channel-split / CRT dissolve into brand-tinted offset channels then buffered video (WebGL, Naked City). index_row: spotlight-dim (hovered row lights an accent rule + surfaces metadata, siblings dim to ~45%) PLUS one of — (a) hover image-preview: a project thumbnail, optionally cursor-attached, reveals on row hover (the canonical Awwwards 'index module' interaction); or (b) scramble-decode on the row label in the terminal expression (a symbol charset shuffled on a short interval — exact charset/interval NOT source-confirmed, treat as illustrative). heading: NEAR-ZERO hover — the effect is the ENTRANCE (type-as-image draw / char-diff / masked per-char rise); RGB split is ONE moment on the hero type only; scramble runs on LABELED elements only, never on prose or headings. nav: transparent + border-bottom:none + backdrop-filter:none at rest, text in the off-black/off-white token (all live-read winners); per-char rollover OR scramble on labels; the nav pill answers with hard-press. cursor: swap the bitmap (body{cursor:url(cursor.svg) 2 0,auto}, matched to the type — Eloy) OR keep the OS pointer with unstyled anchors browser-default blue (Naked City); NEVER a lerped mix-blend-difference follower-blob (that belongs to the smooth-agency archetype).
evidence: Eloy: scramble-on-hover labels, char-diff location tags (type:'diff' 0.3s), custom bitmap cursor (Codrops-verified brutalist); Naked City: CRT dissolve figures, OS pointer + default-blue anchors (winner-verified)
Index hover image-preview: Awwwards 'index module' documentation + nominee entries (Olivier Gillaizeau, Kirschberg) — canon-documented, not tied to a specific brutalist SOTD this run
Sui: full-accent structural fill on nav pills / chips, 2px #000F1D border, radius 0 (award verified; CSS params reference-carried)
FlowFest: hard-press CTA, underline-draw link, tilt-parity ±3° cards, transparent nav (SOTD verified; boundary-adjacent)

algorithm.rule: Pointer classes go DORMANT: underline draw, tilt straighten, scramble-on-hover, per-char rollover, RGB-split hover, CRT dissolve, hover image-preview, the custom bitmap cursor (→ OS pointer), and the cursor-tracked mascot idle loop. The CONTINUOUS idle carry SURVIVES touch through its scroll-driven channels — the marquee runs (velocity-coupled or constant), the scrubbed décor field plucks/shuffles by scroll position, the case slider scrubs, the rAF loop keeps rendering — because none of those depend on the pointer; the mascot cursor-track degrades to a time- or scroll-driven idle fallback. For hover image-preview, the documented mobile fallback flips the index vertical and reveals each row's image when the row centers under scroll. Press-class elements (hard-press buttons, full-accent chips, nav pills) answer the tap with a 90–160ms :active flash — the :active press IS the tap answer. Image sets swap any desktop hold-drag strip for swipe-snap-gallery (native scroll-snap on OS momentum, tap-to-enlarge). Under prefers-reduced-motion: finished states instantly, décor static, marquee paused, scramble → final string, glitch/CRT → static frame, steps counter → instant.
evidence: Eloy / Naked City: the scrubbed décor / rAF loop are scroll-driven so they carry mobile unchanged; hover-only states are the ones that go dormant (mechanics verified)
Index hover-preview mobile fallback: flip the index vertical, reveal the image when the row centers under scroll (Awwwards index-module documentation)
hard-press-button: the :active press is the tap answer (component contract)
Awwwards Mobile Excellence: swipe to see more, tap to enlarge (scored criterion)

cta.hover: hard-shadow press — button rests on box-shadow 0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15); hover translateY(0.25em) collapses the shadow to 0, NO fill and NO colour change (FlowFest, ~0.25s) — the button reads as a physical object lifting. OR full-accent structural fill — border 2px solid near-black, radius 0, background floods the FULL saturated accent while the label colour holds, background-color 0.3s (Sui). NEVER a pale color-mix(accent,white) wash.
cta.tap: :active IS the answer — the hard-shadow collapses / the accent floods on press, 90–160ms; no hover intermediary on touch
cta.focus: :focus-visible mirrors hover (shadow collapse / accent fill) with a visible ring; keyboard-reachable

link.hover: underline draw from the leading edge — a 2px currentColor pseudo-element, transform scaleX(0)→scaleX(1) with transform-origin:left, text colour unchanged; gated @media(hover:hover) and prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference. OR (dense text menus — director lists, indexes) colour dim/shift toward a muted token over color 0.35s, no decoration.

OR RGB channel-split / CRT dissolve — a shader dissolves the still into brand-tinted offset R/G/B channels, then a buffered video autoplays under it after the transition completes (Naked City, WebGL). CSS-only fallback: filter:invert(100%) kept instant or ≤0.2s.

mobile_answer: CARRY-BY-SCROLL, register-aware. The brutalist CONTINUOUS idle carry is the thing the user worries about losing on mobile — and it SURVIVES, because its channels are scroll-driven, not pointer-driven: the marquee keeps running (velocity-coupled or constant), the scrubbed décor field (DrawSVG arch / pixel-field pluck / photo-shuffle carousel) plucks and shuffles by scroll position, the case slider scrubs, and the restraint-register rAF loop keeps rendering. The ONE pointer-dependent idle channel — the cursor-tracked mascot loop (quickTo) — degrades to a time- or scroll-driven idle fallback so the character still moves. Pointer-only STATES go dormant and are @media(hover:hover)-gated so nothing is trapped: underline draw, tilt straighten, scramble-on-hover, per-char rollover, RGB-split hover, CRT dissolve, hover image-preview, and the custom bitmap cursor (→ OS pointer). For the hover image-preview index, the documented mobile fallback flips the index vertical and reveals each row's image when the row centers under scroll. Press-class elements — hard-press buttons, full-accent chips, nav pills — answer the tap with a 90–160ms :active flash (the press IS the tap answer). Image sets swap any desktop hold-drag strip for swipe-snap-gallery (native scroll-snap on OS momentum, tap-to-enlarge — the scored Mobile Excellence line). Under prefers-reduced-motion: every component snaps to its finished state, the marquee pauses, the décor goes static, scramble resolves to the final string, glitch/CRT freeze to a static frame, and the stepped counter jumps instantly — the static frame still reads as deliberately composed.

gaps.mechanic: The brutalist never-silent CARRY — the single most load-bearing missing mechanic for the momentum law. A décor/idle channel run continuously hero→footer so the page is never a bank of fire-once reveals with dead silence between. AMPLITUDE IS PER-BRIEF (correction from revision 1): (LOUD register) a marquee band + ONE in-character idle loop — a mascot/element that tracks the cursor via a lerped quickTo on desktop and falls back to a time- or scroll-driven idle on touch (FlowFest, boundary-adjacent, params reference-carried); (RESTRAINT register) a single perpetual rAF loop that keeps sections subtly moving — Naked City, framed by its makers as 'movement without chaos'. When a marquee ships, couple its speed AND skew to scroll velocity (proxy skew via gsap.quickSetter, ScrollTrigger onUpdate, velocity/−300 clamp, ease back to 0) — the documented Osmo winner variant, and it survives touch as a scroll-driven channel; a constant px/s band is the tamer fallback. Pausable on visibilitychange/off-screen. Distinct from the manifest's ambient-idle (glow/float/shimmer) — this renders the archetype's own metaphor in-character. No manifest component ships a marquee band, a velocity-skew coupling, or a cursor-tracked idle loop with a touch fallback. Priority 1.

The 'dead middle' fix — a décor layer welded to GLOBAL scroll that runs the full page height behind the prose, so the page is never a bank of fire-once reveals with silence between. Two proven flavors: a pixel/SVG field that plucks out path-by-path scrub:8, stagger {each:0.1, from:'random'}, opacity 0, ease bounce.inOut (Eloy flower-pluck, Codrops-verified to the number); and a DrawSVG stroke that draws/undraws itself scrub:0 (FlowFest rainbow arches, reference-carried, boundary-adjacent). Also covers the different-speed title rows (yPercent -300, scrub:0.6, staggered power3.in/power2.in/power1.in) that shear the scroll (Eloy, Codrops-verified). Positional (re-fires every pass), compositor-clean, IO/visibility-gated. The manifest has no scroll-welded décor layer — dolly-zoom is a pinned focal push, shader-surface is a token WebGL ground, neither is a scrubbed line-draw/pluck décor. Priority 1.

The studio-index DEFERRED PEAK — the studio-index climax with no component to build it. Mousemove inside the footer clones the primary CTA up to 200 copies, positioned absolutely at random offsets (~200px steps), each under mix-blend-mode:difference so they interfere; on mouseleave the clones animate out opacity 0, scale 0.6, duration 0.2, ease back.in(1.7), stagger {amount:0.4, from:'random'} (Eloy, Codrops-verified to the number — the best-sourced mechanic in the corpus). Payoff: an unbounded interference field where the loudest interaction lands LAST. Fine-pointer only; on touch the footer is a static reprised CTA. Priority 1.

The canonical studio-index interaction the playbook omitted (integrated in revision 2). Hovering a project name in a list/index reveals a thumbnail — often cursor-attached (lerped toward the pointer) — previewing the work; Awwwards documents this as a named 'index' module (a list of links each with an image that reveals on hover). Distinct from spotlight-dim + scramble (which light/decode the row): this surfaces the WORK. Mobile fallback (documented): flip the index vertical, reveal each row's image when the row centers under scroll. For an archetype whose primary spine is the studio-index, this is the index's canonical hover state. EVIDENCE GRADE: grounded in the Awwwards index-module documentation + nominee entries, NOT tied to a specific 2025-2026 brutalist SOTD this run — canon-documented, not single-winner-verified. Priority 2.

The studio-index hero FORM (the primary brutalist spine's hero). Corner identity tags ('>>>based in madrid, spain') that char-DIFF swap to a second string ('>>>born in mar del plata, arg') via TextPlugin type:'diff', 0.3s, preserveSpaces; a forced-open scramble nav; NO in-fold CTA (the withheld CTA defers activation to the footer finale). Eloy, Codrops-verified. No form/slot contract exists to build the terminal identity hero — only type-as-image (drawn slab) is covered. Priority 2.

The in-character typed loader for the argument spine: a mascot's chat cloud types successive beats via GSAP TextPlugin (all ease:none) — '...' → 'Hi Friends!' → 'We are back...' → the hero's resident line — while .loading-screen fades autoAlpha:0 over 0.3s; then the mascot slides to rest, the nav drops (yPercent −102→0), and the welcome cards stagger. The loader SIGNS its character rather than showing a bare counter. Authored hidden so no-JS never blocks the page. NOTE: FlowFest is a colorful-illustration BOUNDARY member (not tagged brutalist) and these beat/param details live in Slater/GSAP JS, not re-read this run — build the pattern, treat the exact params as illustrative. Priority 2.

WebGL-delegated figure treatment: a custom CRT-screen shader dissolves a still into brand-tinted offset R/G/B channels on hover, then a buffered video autoplays under it after the transition completes (Naked City, winner-verified via Codrops; not CSS-inspectable). Distinct from glitch-type (a CSS RGB-split heading) and figure-hover (contained zoom) — this is a full shader dissolve-to-video on a media figure. Requires a WebGL path; the exact shader uniforms/channel offsets are WebGL-internal (see unverified). CSS-only fallback filter:invert(100%) instant or ≤0.2s. Priority 3.

A brutalist VARIANT of the existing counter-loader: the number ratchets 0→100 in n discrete steps via ease steps(14) (the jump is the brutalist tell, vs the smooth roll), ~3s, then a clip-path inset() wipe hands off — for the studio-reel, the loader Flips the background image to match the showreel video's size/position (GSAP Flip). counter-loader currently rolls smoothly; needs a steps(n) mode + optional Flip hand-off. Award status unverified — technique only. Priority 3.
